# costfluent_savings_view (Resource)

Manages a saved view of a workspace's savings queue: a tab of the queue and its filters under a title, which everyone who can view the queue opens. Each change replaces the view whole, so a filter removed from the configuration is cleared. Needs a token with `manageSavingsItems` and `viewSavingsItems` on the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Rightsizing findings waiting for review that save at least 100 a month, in the provider's
# workspace.
resource "costfluent_savings_view" "rightsizing" {
  title                  = "Rightsizing over 100"
  tab                    = "toReview"
  kind                   = "rightsizing"
  minimum_monthly_saving = "100"
}

# Findings one connection's provider generated, while they are being worked on.
resource "costfluent_savings_view" "aws_in_progress" {
  workspace_id     = "wsp_0000000000000000000001"
  title            = "AWS in progress"
  tab              = "inProgress"
  source           = "awsCostOptimizationHub"
  cloud_account_id = "prv_0000000000000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tab` (String) The tab of the queue the view opens: toReview, inProgress, verified or closed.
- `title` (String) View title, at most 200 characters.

### Optional

- `cloud_account_id` (String) Only findings the provider of this connection generated. A view keeps a connection removed since, and then lists no finding. Every connection when omitted.
- `kind` (String) Only findings of this kind, such as rightsizing, idle, generational, storage, commitmentPurchase, extendedSupport or other. Every kind when omitted.
- `minimum_monthly_saving` (String) Only findings estimated to save at least this much each month, in each finding's own currency, as a decimal string such as "100". The configured spelling is kept while it is the amount the API stores.
- `source` (String) Only findings from this source, such as operator, billingAnalysis or a provider's engine (awsCostOptimizationHub, azureAdvisor, gcpRecommender). Every source when omitted.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID. When omitted, the provider's default workspace at creation is recorded and kept, so a later change to the provider's default does not move it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Savings view ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The configuration sets workspace_id: "<workspace ID>:<savings view ID>". Import with that
# workspace, because changing a configured workspace_id recreates the savings view.
terraform import costfluent_savings_view.aws_in_progress wsp_0000000000000000000001:svw_0000000000000000000001

# The configuration leaves workspace_id out: the bare savings view ID imports from the provider's
# workspace, which state then keeps.
terraform import costfluent_savings_view.rightsizing svw_0000000000000000000001
```
